Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
I have the following errata for this card:

Madness Network - Unique Master (Mal)
*Reaction Cards can be played is response to another Methuselah's action on
your own turn. Action cards and action modifiers can be played whenever you
take an action, even when it is not your turn.[RTR 951110]
*Malkavians may block *in addition* to the normally eligible blockers.[RTR
950530]
*Malkavians do not have to be Ready to take an action via the Network.
(i.e.,
a Torpored Malk could rescue himself from Torpor)[RTR 950509]

The question I have is when the Malk takes an action out of turn, can they
play out of turn master cards during their Madness Networked turn. Common
sense seems to predict no, but hey, since when did Jyhad start using common
sense.

Raille.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Raille wrote:
> The question I have is when the Malk takes an action out of turn, can they
> play out of turn master cards during their Madness Networked turn.

"during the Madness networked action", you mean. Madness Network does not
alter whose turn it is.

The Malk's controller can play an out-of-turn Master card, since
it is not her turn.

> Common
> sense seems to predict no, but hey, since when did Jyhad start using common
> sense.

You can play out-of-turn masters when it is not your turn. The Malk is acting
when it is not your turn. You are not the Malk, you are a Methuselah, so common
sense also predicts "yes" (IMO).
